diogenesProfile.introduction: Professor Diogenes Carvalho Matias shares carefully organized Computer Science study paths for students who are starting the course and need trustworthy material in a clear order.
diogenesProfile.teachingTone: His guidance favors plain explanations, small practice steps, and patient study habits that help beginners understand before they rush into code.
diogenesProfile.promise: Choose a track, open a topic, read the study focus, and leave each page with one practical next action.

preview.heading: A simple route into Computer Science study
preview.body: Students begin with a short professor introduction, compare curated study tracks, open focused topic pages, and use accessibility guidance whenever they need help moving through the platform.
